name: calendly
description: Shows a live Calendly booking calendar on a site page. A public Calendly link is all it needs; signing in to Calendly is optional.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Show your Calendly booking calendar on a page so visitors can book a time.

credentialCards.title: Connect Calendly
credentialCards.label: Calendly account
credentialCards.intro: Optional. Sign in so the assistant can read your event types. Your booking calendar works on your site without this.
usedFor: Lets the assistant find your booking links and scheduled events
credentialCards.keyHint: Browser sign-in only; this connection does not accept a pasted API key.
